statement.value: commands is a list of space-separated strings; amounts are integer minor units. "INIT <account> <balance>" commands come first and create accounts. Timestamped commands follow in non-decreasing day order and are processed in input order. "FUND <day> <account> <amount> <delay>" is accepted when the account exists and settles on day + delay. "BALANCE <day> <account>" reports the settled balance at that point: the starting balance plus accepted funding settled by that day plus all earlier accepted balance changes, or -1 for an unknown account. Return the reported values in order. "WITHDRAW <day> <account> <amount>" is accepted when the account exists and amount does not exceed its settled balance at that point; it lowers the balance immediately. "TRANSFER <day> <from> <to> <amount>" is accepted when both accounts exist, they differ, and amount does not exceed the sender's settled balance; it moves the amount immediately as settled money. "PENDING <day> <account>" reports the sum of accepted, uncancelled funding not yet settled at that day (-1 for an unknown account). "CANCEL <day> <account>" cancels the most recently accepted funding request of the account that is neither settled at that day nor cancelled; it does nothing if there is none.
